# Smart Device Platform — Agent Guide

Short entry point for coding agents. Use this file for start-up discipline only; detailed rules live in [`harness/`](harness/), project navigation lives in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).

## Project Overview

Flutter monorepo for smart-device Apps (glasses, watches, earphones). Priority is establishing platform specs and reusable capabilities first, then incrementally delivering features and Apps.

```text
apps/              App shells, brand and App-specific logic
packages/widget/   Composite pages/components using Feature state (may depend on Feature)
packages/feature/  Complete user scenarios, grouped by domain (device/, ai/, …)
packages/common/   Shared primitives below Feature (no Feature deps)
packages/core/     Base types and cross-App/cross-platform capabilities
specs/             Capability contracts
```

Dependency direction: `App → Widget → Feature → Common → Core`. Full layer model: [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#layer-structure).

## Fact Priority

When conflicts arise, follow the authority order in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority): code and `pubspec.yaml` first, then stable specs, then active architecture docs and ADRs, then draft/planning assets.

`app_configs/` is planning-only and does not participate in the build. `generate_app.dart` is not implemented — do not describe future generation as a current capability.

## Engineering Rules

Read these by intent, not all upfront:

| Need | Source |
|---|---|
| Hard constraints, package boundaries, doc sync | [`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md) |
| Step-by-step task flow | [`harness/checklists.md`](harness/checklists.md) |
| Commands and verification scope | [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md) |
| Project workflow Skills | [`skills/INDEX.md`](skills/INDEX.md) |
| Known BLE / Audio / Riverpod / Navigation traps | [`harness/pitfalls.md`](harness/pitfalls.md) |
| Architecture decisions | [`docs/decisions/`](docs/decisions/README.md) |

## Task Navigation

For the full task map, use [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#navigation-by-task). Common agent routes:

| Task | Start with |
|---|---|
| Choose where a change belongs | `docs/architecture.md` |
| New platform capability / Core package | `specs/README.md`, relevant capability spec, `docs/decisions/0002-graded-core-first.md` |
| New Feature / Common / Widget package | `docs/architecture.md`, `harness/rules.md`, then `harness/checklists.md` |
| New App | `docs/app-dev-runbook.md` |
| Implement or redesign a UI page | `skills/ui-page-implementation/SKILL.md` → `docs/ui-page-workflow.md` |
| Cross-module or multi-session work | `skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md` → `docs/plans/README.md` |
| Existing Provider / API lookup | `docs/implementation-status.md` → Provider Quick Reference |
| Native SDK / protocol / transmission | `native_app/inventory/README.md`, `SDK/index.md`, owning capability Spec |

## Work and Verification

1. Before implementing complex work, use [`plan-lifecycle`](skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md) to select or create one current active Plan.
2. At close-out, use the relevant checklist or Skill and apply only matching rows from the [`Doc Sync Matrix`](harness/rules.md#doc-sync-matrix).
3. Select verification from [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md#command-selection) and report exactly what was not run. Do not describe untested builds, simulator runs, or device runs as passing.

</INSTRUCTIONS>
我会以 0057 计划、原生设置入口和运行时能力实现为基准，区分“已实现但未验证”和“SDK/协议确实缺失”的项，并补查解绑清理是否漏掉设备级数据。
原生与 runtime 的接口边界已确认：当前真正卡住的不是页面代码，而是若干读取/型号化协议没有对外合同。我正在补查所有持久化 key，避免解绑清理只覆盖这次已知的几项。

审计结论：当前 cleanup 已覆盖设置、日程、通话录音、面对面翻译和 AI 联网偏好，但还有三项需要明确处理或记录为保留策略。

| 项目 | 事实与缺口 |
|---|---|
| App LLM 历史 | Flutter 用全局 key `app_llm_history_conversations`，没有账号/设备字段，[history service](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/ai/feature_app_llm/lib/src/service/app_llm_history_service.dart:5)。Android 原生恢复出厂会清理按 `uid + mac` 分区的 `AppLLMCache`，[原生 cache](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/WearfitPro-feat-sdk-glass_sdk_merge_20260521_16kb/module-ai/src/main/java/com/wakeup/module/ai/appllm/AppLLMCache.kt:28)。不能在解绑时直接清全局 Flutter 历史；应明确“跨设备保留”并写入 0057，或后续迁移为账号+设备分区。 |
| 已导入媒体文件 | 持久化目录实际是 `ApplicationSupport/<userId>/<deviceId>/{Imported,Picture,Video,Audio}`，[DeviceMediaLocalStore](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/lib/src/file_transfer/service/device_media_local_store.dart:17)。当前 cleanup 未触及。它们更像用户已导入内容，原生解绑也没有明确删除，建议作为“保留的用户媒体”记录；若产品要求彻底清除，需由 runtime 增加公开 `clearLocalMedia(target)`，不能由 App 拼目录。 |
| 本地范围不统一 | 相册使用登录 `uid/account/guest`，[App 注入](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/apps/glasses_app/lib/app.dart:303)；通话/面对面翻译用 `DeviceAccountScope.storageKey`；录音下载配置仍未在 App override，默认 `userId='default'`，[config](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_record/lib/src/model/device_record_download_config.dart:6)。若将媒体纳入清理，先统一或显式携带这几个 scope。 |
| App LLM 配置 cache | 当前仅删除当前语言的 `cfg_<deviceCode>_<languageId>`，[invalidate](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/ai/feature_app_llm/lib/src/service/app_llm_config_service.dart:231)。多语言使用后会留下其他语言缓存；可接受为可再生 cache，但应标注。 |
| 恢复出厂失败文案 | cleanup 失败同样会走 `factoryResetCleanupFailed`，但现文案只说“账号解绑失败”，[ARB](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/feature/device/feature_device_settings/assets/l10n/app_zh.arb:62)。应改为涵盖解绑或本地清理失败。 |

SDK/协议仍缺：

- `SDK-014` 按键定义：AK/BK key enum 都只有 `unknown`，虽有 setter，但缺型号、物理/触控键、手势、功能码、默认值、读回和 ACK 合同。[AK](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/IOS/sdk/xcframework/VKBLEAKWGlasses.xcframework/ios-arm64/VKBLEAKWGlasses.framework/Modules/VKBLEAKWGlasses.swiftmodule/arm64-apple-ios.swiftinterface:236)；原生页面依赖服务端 `buttonFunctionV2(deviceCode)`，[source](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/SmartGlasses/Setting/Details/Service/WKSmartGlassesKeyDefineService.swift:223)。
- 照片比例：旧 iOS 使用 raw 查询/写入协议，[query](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Component/BLE/WKPeripherals/Apps/BKSmartGlasses/SetApp/WKSmartGlassesSetApp.swift:74)，[set](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Component/BLE/WKPeripherals/Apps/BKSmartGlasses/SetApp/WKSmartGlassesSetApp.swift:114)；现 VK SettingsService 没有 typed 查询、支持项或写入 ACK。
- 语音唤醒和霍尔：只有 setter，没有真实 getter/state stream；BK 也不支持霍尔。[DeviceSettingsClient](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/lib/src/settings/service/device_settings_client.dart:24)。
- 内核版本：旧 iOS 可请求 framework version，[source](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/Controller/DeviceInfo/WKDeviceInfoProvider.swift:48)；新 `DeviceInfoSnapshot` 仅暴露 SN、band/OTA 版本，[runtime model](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/lib/src/identity/service/device_info_snapshot_client.dart:4)。
- BK `supports=260` 是后端设备身份合同缺口，不是 SDK API；字段缺失必须保持未知。

不应误列为 SDK 缺失：视频防抖、视频比例、2K/4K 都是原生 App 本地视频处理能力，不是设备设置协议。[防抖本地偏好](/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/native_app/source_code/wearfitpro-master/ios/howear/Module/MyDevice/SmartGlasses/Home/WKVideoEditor/WKVideoStabilization/WKVideoStabilizationManager.swift:31)。
